figures.caption: Secondary structure analysis of peptides under different conditions by CD spectroscopy. Circular dichroism (CD) spectra of peptides pept_352 (A), pept_1545 (C), pept_84 (D), and melittin (B). Buffer conditions: 100 mM KCl, 1 mM HEPES, 0.2 mM EDTA. The final concentration of the peptide in the experiments was 250 μM.

figures.caption: AMP activity against B. subtilis. Kinetics of propidium iodide (PI) penetration after the addition of AMPs to B. subtilis at a concentration equal to 2× MIC. The negative control corresponds to the bacteria incubated with PI without peptide (MHB).
figures.label: Figure 2

figures.caption: AMPs affect the bacterial membrane integrity. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images of bacterial strains treated with peptides pept_84 and pept_1545 and a positive control, melittin B. subtilis and E. coli were treated with peptides at a final concentration equal to 1/2× and 1× MIC for 8 h, and S. haemolyticus was treated with peptides at a final concentration equal to 1/2× and 1× MIC for 24 h.
